description: Second sensitivity assay for the ~18x conditional-size gap in the COVID arm, covering the two channels covid_sensitivity_assay_v1 named but could not reach: the observational channel (what counts as a 'recorded onset' vs the record's dated-onset bookkeeping, ~3.5x of the gap) and natural history / mixing reach (the ~4.7x over-burn: attack ~0.95 vs the record's ~712/3711 ~0.19). Same declared-replay axis as v1: Theta 4.22e10, same 20 seeds, same cell shape. All arms apply via a NEW arm grammar key 'pathogen_overrides' (a deep-merge patch into run_spec.pathogen_overrides[PATHOGEN_ID]) plus the existing transmission_overrides key (activity_contacts blocks replace wholesale, so every contact arm declares the complete block).
prerequisites: covid_sensitivity_assay_v1 measured: no transmission-layer arm or bound reaches the record; A11 (crew-confined + pool off + day-12 quarantine + perfect confinement + contact dose x0.25) still records ~2868 vs 197 on takeoff seeds
THETA-SCREEN-V11-S2 measured: conditional clause fails ~17.7x at every admissible-band row
thetas_note: Band centre from THETA-SCREEN-V11-REFINE; identical to v1 so B0 reproduces A0 and the two surfaces stack.
seeds_note: Same seed block as v1 (20200205..20200224) so B0 is an exact A0 rerun and arm-vs-arm comparisons share seed realisations.
cells_note: 1 theta x 11 arms x 20 seeds; enumeration axis-point x arm x seed (B0 = cells 0-19, B10 = cells 200-219).

gap_decomposition.observational_share: ~3.5x: recorded_onsets counts every lab-confirmed symptomatic onset; the record's 197 dated onsets is ~28-31% of the ~634 confirmed positives (asymptomatic/paucisymptomatic positives never got a dated onset). Even a correct ~700-infection outbreak reads ~480 on the model's channel.
gap_decomposition.natural_history_share: ~4.7x: sim attack ~0.95 vs record ~0.19. Suspects: effective susceptible pool (sterile/partial immunity, unexposed hosts), infectious-period length, shedding heterogeneity, and contact-network reach (well-mixed zone pools vs a sparse real contact graph).

grammar_additions.pathogen_overrides: arm.overrides.pathogen_overrides merges verbatim into run_spec.pathogen_overrides[sars_cov2_resp] via the existing deep-merge machinery (picard_framework/pathogen_overrides.py); reaches symptomatic_fraction, severity_model.base_probabilities(_by_age_band), shedding_duration_days, shedding_variance_log10, secretor_negative_fraction(+relative_susceptibility), presymptomatic_shedding_days, incubation.
grammar_additions.transmission_overrides_activity_contacts: transmission_overrides already reaches transmission.activity_contacts; the block replaces wholesale so each contact arm declares enabled + the complete rates_per_hour dict (+ optional saturation_hours, CONTACT-ARCH-02).

arms.note: Must reproduce A0_declared seed-for-seed (identical seed block, identical spec). Any drift fingerprints an upstream engine change since b88e0ad.

arms.role: observational: half of symptomatic presenters draw 'subclinical' (onset-ineligible) instead of 'mild'
arms.note: OBSERVATIONAL-CHANNEL arm, bookkeeping counterfactual: the real DP's dated-onset subset excluded paucisymptomatic confirmands. Shifts half of every band's 'mild' mass into 'subclinical' (syndrome_case_eligibility 0) in BOTH base_probabilities and all 17 base_probabilities_by_age_band entries -- onset eligibility [0,0,1,1,1] means a subclinical presenter gets no dated onset while still being SYMPTOMATIC-ill and shedding on the symptomatic curve. Reads how much of the over-read is classification, not biology. Frozen transform: new_subclinical = sub + 0.5*mild, new_mild = 0.5*mild, per band.

symptomatic_fraction is the live presentation draw (natural_history.presentation_probability). 0.40 is the low end of early-SARS-CoV-2 meta-analytic ranges (Buitrago-Garcia's own sensitivity spread). ALSO changes shedding: non-presenters shed on ASYMPTOMATIC_SHEDDING (lower peak) so this arm is confounded biology+observation -- read it as a bound, not a bookkeeping estimate.

Shortens the infectious period ~2x: fewer secondary opportunities per host AND a shorter pre-quarantine burn. Literature-anchored bound on the long end; if the over-burn is a too-long infectious window, this is the single cleanest shrink that is biology rather than bookkeeping.

arms.role: natural history: shedding heterogeneity log10 sd 1.2 -> 2.0
arms.note: Superspreading-tail probe: wider variance concentrates emission in few shedders. On a well-mixed ship this can RAISE total infections (few hosts, huge dose) or lower takeoff; measured direction is the informative output. Declared because dispersion is the least-characterised profile field.

arms.role: natural history: 50% of the population carries sterile innate immunity
arms.note: EFFECTIVE-POPULATION bound: flags half the agents immune at init, capping attack at ~50% regardless of exposure intensity. Tests the 'the real ship's susceptible pool was much smaller than 3711' hypothesis -- cross-reactive immunity / prior-exposure frailty is the standing literature suspect for DP's 19% attack.
Deep end of B5: ~928 susceptibles. If B5 lands near the record this arm overshoots into collapse; if B5 still over-produces, the residual is reach, not pool size.

arms.role: mixing: every activity_contacts partner rate halved
arms.note: REACH probe on the partner/contact channel (distinct from v1's dose-side A6/A7): halves how many distinct partners each activity draws, shrinking the exposed set rather than the per-exposure dose. Complete block declared because activity_contacts replaces wholesale.

arms.role: mixing: per-visit contact saturation (CONTACT-ARCH-02) switched on
arms.note: Declares saturation_hours per activity: partners per visit plateau at rate*tau*(1-exp(-t/tau)) instead of growing linearly with dwell -- the model's measured-form answer to 'a 12-hour cabin stay does not yield 12x the partners of a 1-hour stay'. Taus are STRUCTURAL declarations (a per-visit plateau exists), not fitted values; the set is a single frozen sweep point. If saturation is the missing realism, during-window mass drops while the early burn survives.

arms.role: mixing bound: half rates AND saturation
arms.note: Combined reach bound on the partner channel; pairs B7 and B8 to bound total reach from below.

arms.role: counterfactual floor: observational + natural history + reach combined
arms.note: Same role as v1's A11: if even the combined observational+natural-history+reach bound cannot put 197 inside the conditional q05-q95, the residual suspect is structural -- zone-pool well-mixing itself (every susceptible reachable by every shedder) or the Theta composite -- and the next step is engine surgery, not parameter assay.

observational_annex.statement: No cells: a scoring annex on this assay's and v1's payloads. Per cell compute confirmed_proxy = recorded_onsets + campaign_asymptomatic_positives and dated_share = recorded_onsets / confirmed_proxy, beside the record's 197/712 dated-confirmed bookkeeping; report the implied 'dated-onset-equivalent' = recorded_onsets x 0.31 alongside raw recorded_onsets so both metrics' gaps are visible. Declared approximate: campaign_asymptomatic_positives undercounts confirmed positives outside specimen days.

scoring.statement: FROZEN before any assay cell exists. Per arm, on the seeds that took off in BOTH the arm and B0 (recorded_onsets >= 10 under each): (i) median recorded_onsets and ratio to B0's takeoff-seed median; (ii) q05-q95 and whether it contains 197; (iii) fraction in the near-target band [98.5, 394]; (iv) median infections_total vs ~712; (v) median attack_rate vs ~0.19; (vi) the annex's dated-onset-equivalent median vs 197; (vii) arm takeoff count. NOTE: every arm here perturbs profile draws, so seed realisations are NOT draw-aligned with B0 -- paired-seed filters are retained for comparability but stream-pairing is not assumed; reads are distribution-level.

verdict_bands.closes_the_gap: conditional recorded_onsets q05-q95 contains 197 AND conditional median in [98.5, 394]
verdict_bands.load_bearing: conditional recorded_onsets median falls >= 50% vs B0

scoring.note: Same caveat as v1: counterfactual arms are physically/historically false by declaration; 'closes_the_gap' names WHERE the over-burn lives, it is not a fitted configuration.

what_this_cannot_settle: Zone-pool well-mixing: every contact/dose lever still leaves every zone-susceptible reachable by every zone-shedder. A sparse-contact-graph counterfactual needs engine surgery (a contact network), not overrides -- if B10 fails, that is the named residual.
True seed pairing: all arms perturb profile RNG draws.
The generic-voyage H3 admissibility of any suppressed configuration.

execution.platform: AWS Batch EC2 Spot via deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh DESIGN=covid_sensitivity_assay_v2; image built from a main containing this file; pinned job-def revision + sha256 digest.
execution.canary: Two rows: (a) INDEX_OFFSET 0 = B0_declared, witness against A0_declared's payload statistics (identical seeds -> identical payload expected); (b) INDEX_OFFSET 200 = B10_mixed_floor, wiring proof for pathogen_overrides -- spec dump must show symptomatic_fraction 0.4, shedding_duration_days 8, secretor_negative_fraction 0.5, the patched severity bands, and the saturated activity_contacts block; payload must differ from B0's on the same seeds.
report_immediately_if: B10_mixed_floor still over-produces by more than ~4x -- the residual is then structural (well-mixed zones / Theta composite), not parametric
B0 witness does not reproduce A0_declared seed-for-seed
